exposure: The two-pose and fixed100ms sensor maps are exposed; ChatGPT subsequently proposed virtual concentration versus a common-intensity-matched control. Its response was based only on a textual summary, not raw data.
question: Can two exact, finite, in-domain olfactory tapes isolate the lateral component of the 2-degree virtual-yaw stimulus over the fixed postwind100ms, while retaining the virtual branch itself? No CNS is run here.
operation: For every input step1021..1120, intervention=(L_Y,R_Y), control=(L_0+delta_m,R_0+delta_m), delta_m=mean(virtual)-mean(baseline). Thus both means equal virtual mean and the difference is exactly antisymmetric; use the original body forward/yaw/wind command tape in both prospective arms.
information: Frozen Stage40 sensor/body trace and prospective CPU virtual-yaw map only. This synthetic evaluator intervention does not pass source coordinates, bearing or targets to the organism.

alternatives.A_valid_pair: All100 rows are in [0,1], means match within1e-15, branch difference sums to zero within1e-15, and absolute L-R difference exceeds0.0001 in every row; the input contrast is well defined, not yet a neural result.
alternatives.B_unobservable_or_invalid: Any row violates domain/common matching/clock or the contrast floor; do not run a neural branch on this tape.
alternatives.C_original_context_drift: Baseline tape no longer matches the actual donor pending/consumed samples; stop before interpreting branch differences.

stop: Generate once from fixed100ms rows; no tuning of magnitude, start, duration, mean or sign after seeing the tape. Neural use needs a separate budget and exact shared checkpoint/restoration/physical tape controls.
